A dissertation is set on the Graduate School's margins: an inch and a half
at the left, where it is bound, and an inch elsewhere. Those used to be
written over whatever the document asked for. Now the body takes a margin the
document names and keeps the Graduate School's for the sides it does not.
The front matter keeps the Graduate School's margins whatever is asked:
those pages are a requirement, set page by page.
